name: std::stop_source::get_token
intro: Returns a stop_token object associated with the stop_source's stop-state, if the stop_source has stop-state; otherwise returns a default-constructed (empty) stop_token.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A stop_token object, which will be empty if this->stop_possible() == false.

summary: Returns a stop_token object associated with the stop_source's stop-state, if the stop_source has stop-state; otherwise returns a default-constructed (empty) stop_token.
